body: Hmmm, you should not need it as of bazel 0.4.4. What is the output of `bazel version`?

```
Build label: 0.4.4-homebrew
Build target: bazel-out/local-opt/bin/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/bazel/BazelServer_deploy.jar
Build time: Thu Feb 2 01:05:15 2017 (1485997515)
Build timestamp: 1485997515
Build timestamp as int: 1485997515
```
I am seeing a similar issue on bazel 0.4.4 only using the SDK (no NDK). Please let me know if you need more details and I'll post a full reproducer.

Hmmm, I'll try to take a look tomorrow. For the sake of linking things together, the tracking issue for this bug was https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/1928.

I noticed that you changed the target in the example from 25.0.0 to 25.2.0. Perhaps that is related? I will admit I have not tried any builds with the 25.2.0 app compat library, however I can't imagine any difference in its contents causing this error.

Do both of the following builds fail?

```
$ bazel build @androidsdk//com.android.support:appcompat-v7-25.0.0
$ bazel build @androidsdk//com.android.support:appcompat-v7-25.2.0
```

@hochhaus, are you also using mac?
@aj-michael Yes, I'm compiling the same target both on linux and mac. Linux works as expected. The error only occurs on the mac for me.
@aj-michael Both of build failed for the same not exist error.

body:
Hmm, both https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/0f119a4db515105217244e4db5d4fed9371ef1a4/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/sandbox/DarwinSandboxedStrategy.java and https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/0f119a4db515105217244e4db5d4fed9371ef1a4/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/sandbox/LinuxSandboxedStrategy.java invoke https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/0f119a4db515105217244e4db5d4fed9371ef1a4/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/sandbox/SpawnHelpers.java#L166 which is what mounts empty directories for empty TreeArtifacts.

@philwo do you have any idea of what might cause this discrepancy in the sandbox strategies?

Ah, I think I see the problem. That DarwinSandboxedStrategy uses a HardlinkedExecRoot, while the LinuxSandboxedStrategy uses a SymlinkedExecRoot. Since you can't make hard links to directories... we may be out of luck here.

Icky. This is a show stopper for `android_binary()` to work well cross platform.

Is it possible to force bazel on darwin to use the `SymlinkedExecRoot` for `android_binary()` rules?

So I spoke a bit too soon. HardlinkedExecRoot does handle directory inputs, however the way it handles them is by hard linking each of the directory entries:

https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/0f119a4db515105217244e4db5d4fed9371ef1a4/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/sandbox/HardlinkedExecRoot.java#L151

Then, in the process of creating the hardlinks for the children, it creates the parent directory. However, in the case of an empty tree artifact (_aar/unzipped/resources/support-compat-25.2.0), this means that the directory never gets created.

So it seems a simple fix is to call `FileSystemUtils.createDirectoryAndParents(source);` at https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/0f119a4db515105217244e4db5d4fed9371ef1a4/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/sandbox/HardlinkedExecRoot.java#L151.

@philwo is there any reason that we would not want to do this? Otherwise I will send you a patch to review.
